module

public import Mathlib.Topology.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Defs

@[expose] public section

/-- A space is homogeneous if its homeomorphism group acts transitively. -/
class HomogeneousSpace (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] : Prop where
  is_transitive : ∀ x y : X, ∃ f : Homeomorph X X, f x = y

sources_consulted: Halverson, D. M. and Repovš, D., “The Bing-Borsuk and the Busemann Conjectures,” Mathematical Communications 13 (2008), 163–184, especially §§2–3. Read the v2 LaTeX source from https://arxiv.org/e-print/0811.0886 and version information at https://arxiv.org/abs/0811.0886.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homogeneous_space — introduction and Formal definition, including its nonempty G-space convention.

Arhangel’skii, A. V., “Selected Old Open Problems in General Topology” (2013), the topological-space convention, definition of homogeneity, and §6: https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf

review.notes:
Checked HomogeneousSpace and its field against the sources and Mathlib. The quantifiers and bundled homeomorphisms express exactly the standard point-to-point definition. Empty spaces satisfy this condition; this agrees with the topology-specific source definition. Mathlib calls the corresponding evaluation action pretransitive and additionally requires nonemptiness for transitivity in the single-orbit sense.

The only direct problem consumer is BingBorsuk.bing_borsuk_conjecture, whose homogeneity assumption matches its source. Paper/Homogenous.lean instead defines a separate namespaced class; I proved that the two classes are equivalent. The cited Bing–Borsuk sources do not contradict its recorded open status.

/workspace/review/scratch.lean and /workspace/review/use_sites.lean compile without errors, warnings, or sorry. Checks include pointwise/unbundled/pretransitive equivalences, the nonempty single-orbit characterization, empty and singleton spaces, arbitrary discrete and indiscrete spaces, rejection of the Sierpiński space, and computed swap witnesses on Fin 0 through Fin 3. The repository was left unchanged.
